coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Non-traded REIT subscription agreement (landscape print of an appendix): the investor completes sections 1-7 and 9-10 (pages 6-18) and signs on page 19 (individual owner) or page 21 (trust, corporation, partnership); a joint owner signs and initials beside them; a custodian signs custodial accounts; the registered representative and an authorized principal of the broker-dealer complete section 8 and sign (pages 15-16). No issuer acceptance block.

sure_per_page.8: sure; the custodian table is completed by the investor about their custodian; the digit-mark rows are one place per number
sure_per_page.10: sure of the places; the table captions sit at the top of each band (the writing room is under the caption); the joint table is captioned joint owner or minor (co-investor; for a minor the custodian writes it)
sure_per_page.12: sure; the trust and entity tables are separated from the individual table
sure_per_page.15: sure; the whole section is completed by the broker-dealer
sure_per_page.16: sure; the second signature band has no room under its caption
sure_per_page.19: sure; the custodian's signature band has no room under its caption; the custodian's name band is cut by the page break
sure_per_page.20: sure; the tail of the custodian name band

1: the issuer's address block, the prospectus date gap (issuer) and the paragraphs
6: the frame under the RIA sentence; headings
8: the funds-to gap in the registration paragraph (issuer); headings
9: the empty captionless band at the top (the social security cell continued over the page break) and the empty captionless band at the foot of the table
12: the investor / co-investor column headings over the initials; the empty captionless band at the foot of the entity table
17: the company contact information (printed issuer details, its empty e-mail line included); the escrow and wire details
